title: CONCH
paper_title: A Visual-Language Foundation Model for Computational Pathology
core_mech: 在病理领域把 CLIP 式全局对比与 CoCa 式图像条件 caption decoder 联合训练，同时服务判别与生成。
core_mech_en: CoCa-style computational pathology vision–language foundation model jointly trained with contrastive image–text alignment and generative caption decoding on 1.17M pairs.
input_desc: 组织病理图像与人工生成的病理文本描述
input_en: Histopathology image tile/ROI + paired pathology text description or prompt
output_desc: 病理图文共享表征及图像条件文本生成
output_en: Shared multimodal retrieval/zero-shot embeddings + autoregressive pathology caption/text generation

gaps: CONCH requires its pathology vision–language architecture and objectives; neither the CLIP lesson nor a generic pathology classifier is a CONCH reproduction.
